NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author squashed the history into one commit on current `main`, also changed the parser to keep multi-line text, and says the checklist is complete. CI is passing now.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Commit history is clean: one commit, "outgoing_webhooks: Parse command and text for Slack webhooks." |
| ❌  | Self-review checklist is not complete: "Automated tests verify logic where appropriate" is still unchecked, even though the comment says it is done. |
| ❌  | The PR doesn't explain how it relates to the other open PRs for #19589 (#38098, #39481, #39606). A similar PR (#38902) was closed for this reason. |
| ⚠️  | The author never ran the new test locally and relies on CI. Nothing addresses the earlier `python-zulip-api` compatibility question on this issue. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to finish the checklist and explain how this PR differs from the other open PRs for #19589.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commits! Two things are still missing: the "Automated tests verify logic where appropriate" box in the self-review checklist is unchecked, and the description doesn't say how this PR relates to the other open PRs for #19589 (#38098, #39481, #39606); see our [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please update the description and post again to request a review.
```
